ui_bugs.issue: Unhandled AxiosError (403) surfaces as React 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay on /auth and other pages when app attempts API calls without a token on mount. Requests should be guarded by auth state or the rejection caught.

Ensure authenticated-only API calls are gated on token presence (AuthProvider) before firing on mount.
Add data-testid to name input and register CTA (name-input/register-submit) to improve test automation reliability.

rca_of_the_issue: React dev build shows 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay whenever a promise rejects (AxiosError 403). When page mounts on /auth or anywhere pre-login, API calls made without Authorization header hit 401/403 and, because the rejection isn't caught in the component, React's error overlay (react-error-overlay / webpack-dev-server) renders the stack. Fix: wrap each useEffect fetch in try/catch or .catch(() => ...); or gate calls on `if (!token) return;` in AuthContext-consuming pages.
